versions.subject: split sysmon_stickykey_like_backdoor.yml
versions.detection:
selection_process:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\winlogon.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'sethc.exe'
        - 'utilman.exe'
        - 'osk.exe'
        - 'Magnify.exe'
        - 'Narrator.exe'
        - 'DisplaySwitch.exe'
condition: selection_process
